title: Melting Bernini Columns
summary: Procedurally melts baroque Solomonic columns with an animated noise marble shader, overhang controls, and VR-ready parameters.

vr_notes.comfort: Rotate columns and melt speed can be disabled for comfort-first sessions.
vr_notes.performance: Keep vertical_segments <= 80 for standalone headsets; shader displacement is the heaviest pass.
vr_notes.interaction: Parameters expose smoothly lerped values suitable for dial or slider inputs.

parameters.name: column_height
parameters.description: World-space height of each column before melt compression.

parameters.name: column_radius
parameters.description: Base radius prior to rib and chaos modifiers.

parameters.name: spiral_density
parameters.description: Number of helical turns carved into the shaft.

parameters.name: melt_strength
parameters.description: Amount of downward compression applied during melting.

parameters.name: overhang_factor
parameters.description: Controls sideward slumping toward the top of the column.

parameters.name: bulge_amplitude
parameters.description: Scales radial bulges along the shaft.

parameters.name: chaos_factor
parameters.description: Adds sinusoidal noise for organic irregularities.

parameters.name: rib_count
parameters.description: Number of fluted ribs carved around the circumference.

parameters.name: rotate_columns
parameters.description: Enables slow rotation choreography for the column cluster.

parameters.name: animate_melting
parameters.description: When true, regenerates the shaft mesh every frame using update_column_mesh.

parameters.name: use_marble_shader
parameters.description: Toggles the procedural marble shader applied to each column shaft.

parameters.name: marble_vein_contrast
parameters.description: Sharpens the sine-driven vein bands in the marble shader.
